Great to meet earlier — thanks for walking us through the analytics workflow and the specific latency and multi-tenant isolation concerns. Quick recap from my side and a proposed path to get a technical deep dive scheduled:

- Primary goal: sub-150ms median token latency for short-form generation across 3 regional clusters.
- Data constraints: PII redaction for logs, 90-day retention, and an encrypted-at-rest requirement.
- Purchase timing: target decision by end of Q3; procurement will need SOC2 + sample contract redlines.

Immediate next steps I recommend:
1) Schedule a 60–75 minute technical deep dive (runtime + network architecture + SSO) with your infra and security folks.
2) Loop in your procurement contact so we can share SOC2 evidence and align on procurement timing.
3) Share a short POC scope so we can size dedicated capacity and estimate cost.

If those windows don't work, tell me two alternatives and Marissa will coordinate. I’ll also bring Priya (security solutions) and Sean (platform ops) on the invite once we lock time.

Thanks — excited to keep momentum.
